info.title: API.SH: Lidl
info.description: The Lidl API from API.SH: public Lidl data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route prefix, e.g. /tiktok/v1

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
A Lidl country's shop categories with ids, names, product counts and subcategories, and the total product count.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lidl-categories

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Lidl shop (default DE).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A country's current and coming Lidl leaflets (name, dates, offer dates, status, category, link, PDF and thumbnail); with `id`, one leaflet's pages (image and the links on each page) and every product in it (id, title, brand, price, category, description, image, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lidl-flyers

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Shop country (default DE), e.g. GB, FR, NL, PL, ES, IT.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A leaflet id from the list (or its link) to get its pages and products.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on offer now in a Lidl country, biggest discount first: the same fields as search (price, old price, discount, unit price, offer dates, Lidl Plus prices). Narrow by keywords, category or any search filter. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null when the offers end.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lidl-offers

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Lidl shop: DE, GB, FR, NL, BE, AT, CH, PL, CZ, SK, HU, ES, IT, IE, SE, DK, FI, RO, BG, HR, SI, LT, LV, GR, CY (default DE).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Only offers matching these keywords.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Only offers in this category (from /lidl/v1/categories).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default discount).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-96 (default 24).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Lidl product, or up to 20, by product number (or the first search result for `q`): everything in search plus the full original record. With `details=true`, also EANs, manuals, long description, variants and delivery terms.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lidl-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product number (the digits after /p in a lidl link, e.g. 100410438), the link, or up to 20 comma-separated.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Instead of id: return the first search result for these keywords (Lidl's range changes weekly).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Lidl shop (default DE).

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: `true` adds `details` from the product page: EANs, long description, summary, PDF manuals, info tabs, variant options with their product numbers, videos and delivery terms. Costs more; up to 5 ids.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Lidl product search in 25 countries: id, link, title, brand, category path, price, old and recommended price, discount percent, amount and text, unit price (per kg/L), packaging, offer start and end dates, VAT, Lidl Plus prices, deal-of-the-day and flash-sale flags, ribbons, rating, rating count and recommendations, online / in-store availability, highlights, images, energy labels, seals and regional prices. Filter by category, brand, price range, minimum rating, availability, in-store, new or any facet the shop lists in `facets`; every sort the shop offers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lidl-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search keywords (optional with category, category_id or brand).

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Lidl shop: DE, GB, FR, NL, BE, AT, CH, PL, CZ, SK, HU, ES, IT, IE, SE, DK, FI, RO, BG, HR, SI, LT, LV, GR, CY (default DE).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order: relevance (default), price_asc, price_desc, newest, rating, bestsellers, discount.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A category name from `facets` (e.g. Essen & Trinken); repeat for several.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: A category id from /lidl/v1/categories, e.g. 10068374.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: A brand from `facets`, e.g. SILVERCREST; repeat for several.

parameters.name: price_min
parameters.description: Lowest price.

parameters.name: price_max
parameters.description: Highest price.

parameters.name: rating_min
parameters.description: Minimum star rating, 1-5.

parameters.name: available_only
parameters.description: true for products available now only.

parameters.name: in_store
parameters.description: true for in-store products only.

parameters.name: new
parameters.description: true for new products only.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any other facet as code=value from `facets`, several separated by ; (e.g. Kaffeeart=Bohnen).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-96 (default 24).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A country's Lidl stores, page by page, or one store by its number: store number, name, address, coordinates, open status, the next seven days' opening hours, services (parking, charging, bakery, ...), offer region and operating company.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/lidl-stores

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: Country (default DE), e.g. GB, FR, NL, PL.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A store number such as DE00347 (instead of the list).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Stores per page (default 50, max 100).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
